title: Import shadowed within a function effects invalid code
body:

There is a http://rollupjs.org reproduction [here](https://rollupjs.org/repl?version=0.41.6&). Essentially, this code:

```js
import { e } from "./e";

export function something() {
    try {
        console.log(e);
    } catch (e) { // the catch identifier shadows the import
        console.error(e);
    }
}
```

results in a bundle that contains:

```js
export function something() {
    try {
        console.log(e);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e$$1);
    }
}
```

Where `e$$1` is not defined.

My quick search through the repo for issues found [this](https://github.com/rollup/rollup/pull/155) PR that included a test for a shadowed import that used a wildcard. I would have expected that named imports could be similarly shadowed.
